state.seed_assertion: Systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person, is one type of processing that always requires a DPIA.

sentences.1: Systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person, is one type of processing that always requires a DPIA.
sentences.10: a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person
sentences.11: Systematic evaluation, scoring, prediction, prognosis and profiling, especially of aspects concerning the data subject's economic situation, health, personal preferences or interests, reliability or behaviour, location or movements or the credit rating of data subjects is a type of processing subject to DPIA requirement.
sentences.12: Systematic evaluation, scoring, prediction, prognosis and profiling, especially of aspects concerning the data subject's economic situation, health, personal preferences or interests, reliability or behaviour, location or movements or the credit rating of data subjects.
sentences.13: A DPIA must be done when personal data is collected from a source other than the individual without providing them with a privacy notice because of application of article 14(5)(b) GDPR in conjunction with the criterion that personal data is processed for evaluation or scoring of the data subject.
sentences.14: DPIA must be done when personal data is collected personal data from a source other than the individual without providing them with a privacy notice because of application of article 14 5 b GDPRin conjunction with at least one other following criteria - personal data is processed for evaluation or scoring of the data subject
sentences.2: Article 35(3) sets out three types of processing which always require a DPIA: Systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects: "(a) any systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person."
sentences.3: Extensive evaluation and profiling of individuals, including large-scale processing with scoring, evaluating, predicting and profiling, is a criterion triggering DPIA requirements.
sentences.4: Extensive evaluation and profiling of individuals - Explanation and examples: Large scale processing of personal data including scoring, evaluating, predicting and profiling of individuals
sentences.5: A DPIA is required in the case of a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
sentences.6: a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person
sentences.7: A DPIA is required for a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling.
sentences.8: A DPIA is required at least in the following cases: a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling
sentences.9: A data protection impact assessment is required for systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
